figure.title: Plaque assay: Toxoplasma plaques
figure.text: A crystal-violet plaque-assay well from a published figure. Plaques are segmented by spaCR's plaque model. This well was not used to train the model.
figure.alt: Greyscale image of a crystal-violet stained well with pale plaques in a dark monolayer

model.note: An alternative plaque model in the zoo, not the default (toxoplasma_plaque_v3 is the default). Card test set: F1 0.815 on 263 held-out fields (v3 0.844). 98 plaques in the hand-drawn mask; F1 0.96 at IoU 0.5 on this well

facts: Cabral G, et al. Microbiol Spectrum 2024, Fig. 2

assay_caption: toxoplasma_plaque_v4 found 100 plaques against 98 hand-drawn (TP 95, FP 5, FN 3; F1 0.96 at IoU 0.5) on a held-out CC BY 4.0 well (Cabral et al. 2024); v3, the default, scores F1 0.964 (99 plaques) on the same well with the same call.

evidence.zoo_default: toxoplasma_plaque_v3 (spacr.submodules.DEFAULT_PLAQUE_MODEL at spaCR nightly f302d2ef2); v4 is registered as 'alternative, not the default'
